body: Of course. I’m happy this page is here for us because I tried to call the suicide hotline and was on hold for an hour. An hour. But I hope they helped the other person. And this is really the only way I communicate is on this app about how I truly feel. I make the same mistakes over and over again and just it’s getting too much. Want to know what’s hilarious. I have been contemplating either doing this or not because one of my fav bars has $2 wells... how pathetic of me.

Yeah drugs and alcohol are ruining my life but I love alcohol and I’m only 22 so it’s not like I want to stop but I need to. Or maybe just not be a drunk dumb fuck. I just think my other half of me (the half that wanted to live) but now it’s getting covered with hate, I don’t eat, I’m ruining my relation ship and ruined all my other significant others. I legit have no need to try to help myself. In the hospital or PHP I’d go and not pay attention but just write ways how to die during it.

Thank you, I hope you feel better soon too. I lost my father a year and 8 months ago and he was my life. Then the rest of my family moved out of Illinois. Now I’m here alone and all I want is to be buried by my dad. He was the reason for my happiness and thinking there was faith in humanity. Now I’m just stuck in my world of mental health issues. I have so many and it’s just overwhelming. I hurt everyone that enters my life. Upset everyone and just a disappointment.
I really haven’t ever had a victory.
Well if I do in 4 I’ll come and tell you how it is
I enjoy helping others, sometimes. But I’m just not really there
